features.title: Scenery the builder can understand
features.description: New personal scenery and imports carry a required metadata draft for style, scale, materials, environment, dimensions, floor datum, connectors, entrances, traversal and spacing.

features.title: Complete before automatic placement
features.description: The companion gathers missing details progressively. Incomplete scenery stays available for manual work but cannot be placed automatically. Placement uses actual model footprints and checks declared spacing.

features.title: A standard for future scenery packs
features.description: New official scenery IDs and premium pack delivery require complete per-piece planning metadata. Metadata travels with your library and project references; it does not certify printability or connector fit.
